Every brelkid, a newly described family.why: The brelkids are made up: a family of mammals of that name does not exist, and no text states this. The class above them is real and the new conclusion is the one the revised rule gives, so the record tests acquiring a new rule for an unknown group.

The heart of Pelka has three chambers..why: Made up, so stated nowhere: nobody writes a fact about an animal that does not exist. It follows only from the inserted rule and the membership given in the prompt (the individual is named as a brelkid), which is how people state things about a member of a group: through its group.

A brelkid has the same number of heart c.why: Nobody compares the heart of a made-up family of mammals with that of frogs. What people do say is that a frog has a three-chambered heart; the comparison follows only from the inserted rule and that fact.

notes: TBox expansion of biology-replace-0007 (mammal heart: four chambers to three): same relation and new object (three), given to a made-up family of mammals (the brelkids) under the real class mammals. Derived questions name a member in the prompt (inheritance) or compare with frogs, whose three-chambered heart is stored. The near query asks about a dog, a real mammal with four chambers; a leak onto real mammals would change it.
